What is the eligibility criteria for a H: To qualify for a Home Loan, you must be a citizen aged 21-65, with a minimum monthly salary of ₹25,000 (salaried) or a stable business income (self-employed), and a CIBIL score of 750 or above.
What is the eligibility criteria for a P: For a Personal Loan, you must be aged 21-60 with a minimum monthly income of ₹20,000, at least 1 year of continuous employment, and a CIBIL score of 720+.
What is the eligibility criteria for a V: For a Vehicle Loan, you need to be aged 21-65, have a minimum monthly income of ₹15,000, and a CIBIL score of 700 or above.
What is the eligibility criteria for a B: For a Business Loan, your business must have a vintage of at least 2 to 3 years, a profitable track record, GST registration, and a minimum annual turnover of ₹10 lakhs.
What is the age limit for a Home Loan?: The minimum age to apply for a Home Loan is 21 years, and the maximum age at loan maturity should not exceed 65 years (70 years for self-employed).
What is the minimum income for a Home Lo: The minimum monthly net income required for a Home Loan is ₹25,000 for salaried individuals living in tier-1 cities.
Does a co applicant improve loan eligibi: Yes, adding a co-applicant allows the bank to club both incomes, which increases your overall eligibility and loan amount limit.
What is business vintage?: Business vintage is the number of years a business has been actively registered and running, which must be at least 3 years for unsecured loans.
Are NRIs eligible for Home Loans?: Yes, Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) are eligible to apply for Home Loans to buy property in India, subject to NRI verification.
What is the minimum credit score require: A credit score of 700 is the absolute minimum, but a score of 750+ is preferred to secure low-interest rates.
Can self employed individuals get a loan: Yes, self-employed professionals (doctors, CAs, architects) and business owners can apply by providing income proof like audited balance sheets and ITR.
Does my existing debt affect my eligibil: Yes, your Fixed Income to Debt Ratio (FOIR) must be under 50%, meaning all active monthly loan repayments cannot exceed half of your net income.
Can I get a loan if my salary is paid in: It is difficult, as banks require official bank statement credits or salary slips to verify consistent monthly salary income.
What is the maximum loan amount I can ge: The maximum amount is determined by your net income, age, CIBIL score, and the value of the collateral (LTV limit of 80%).
Can students apply for an Education Loan: Yes, students can apply as co-borrowers, with their parents, guardians, or spouses acting as the primary financial co-applicants.
What is the minimum age for a Personal L: The minimum age to apply for an unsecured Personal Loan is 21 years.
What is the maximum age for a Personal L: The maximum age for a Personal Loan is 60 years at the time of loan completion.
Does a high CIBIL score guarantee loan a: A high score increases your chances, but does not guarantee it, as banks also evaluate your income, employment stability, and properties.
Can I get a loan if I recently changed m: Yes, if your job changes are within the same industry and you have a total continuous work experience of at least 2 years.
What is the minimum work experience requ: For salaried applicants, lenders generally look for at least 1 year of total work experience and 6 months with the current employer.
Are pensioners eligible for loans?: Yes, pensioners are eligible for specialized personal loans, provided they receive their pension through our bank and are under 76 years of age.
Can I apply for a loan with a low monthl: Yes, by adding a co-applicant with a stable income or by offering additional security/collateral.
What is the minimum turnover for busines: The minimum annual turnover required for an MSME business loan is ₹10 lakhs as declared in GST filings.
Is property value checked for eligibilit: Yes, the loan amount is capped at a certain percentage (LTV) of the property's market value, which is evaluated by the bank.
